subject: Security scoping: MAP gates & data retention (NovaCorp)
messages:
From: James Li <james.li@novacorp.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@novacorp.com>, security@novacorp.com
Date: 2027-04-27T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: NovaCorp security scoping for MAP / data retention

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the demo last week — NovaCorp is excited about the latency and cost profile. Before we finalize the MAP and move to procurement, legal and security need a short scoping call and some clarifications so we can lock the close timeline. High level asks: 

- SOC 2: do you have a recent Type II or an expected date for Type II? Can we get the report or an SSP extract?
- SIG/CAIQ: do you have a completed self-assessment or external attestation we can review?
- DPA: would you share your standard DPA and confirm any non-negotiables (data flow, subprocessors)?
- Data retention: our security team needs explicit retention options for tokens, KV cache, and audit logs; must confirm deletion SLA for customer data and backups.

Attached: Nova_Security_Questionnaire_v1.pdf — the team filled initial fields. Our target: finish security gating and legal review by 2027-05-10 so procurement can issue PO the week after. Is that feasible?

Thanks,
James Li
Director, Cloud Security
NovaCorp

Attachments: Nova_Security_Questionnaire_v1.pdf (pdf)

James — thanks for the questionnaire and clear timeline. Looping in Ben (AE) to keep the MAP aligned, Marcus (Solutions) for technical retention/archival details, and Laura (Legal) for the DPA/redline path. Proposed next steps (short MAP):

1) Today: Redwood to share existing artifacts (SOC notes, SIG summary, DPA template, MAP skeleton).
2) 2027-04-29: 45-minute technical sync (retention, KV cache, encryption, deletion SLA).
3) 2027-05-03: Legal/Procurement redline due back; we respond within 48 hours.
4) 2027-05-10: Target for security/contract signoff, PO issuance.

For transparency: we can provide a SOC 2 Type II report by end of Q2 (target 2027-06-30). In the interim we can share our SOC 2 Type I summary and the latest control matrix. Marcus — can you attach a short retention-options doc and confirm whether NovaCorp's requested 90-day restore window for backups is compatible?

Attached: MAP-draft-outline.xlsx — includes the proposed MAP milestones and owner assignments.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

- Deal id DN-4891 on our side.

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: James Li <james.li@novacorp.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-29T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NovaCorp security scoping for MAP / data retention — technical details

James / team — notes from the technical side and proposals for the MAP gate: 

- Retention layers: tokens (transient, default TTL 24h but configurable per-customer), KV cache (default TTL 7 days, configurable), audit logs (retained 90 days by default; longer retention available via add-on).
- Deletion SLA: for customer-requested deletion of active data we support an API-driven purge with a 72-hour acknowledgement and 30-day full-erase window for primary data. Backups: we can schedule accelerated purge of snapshots within 90 days with a contractual addendum; immediate deletion of cold backups is not typical due to snapshot immutability, but we can commit to a documented process and timeline.
- Encryption & keys: data-at-rest encrypted, customer-managed keys supported via KMS/HSM for Private deployments.
- Evidence: we can provide a SIG/CAIQ self-assessment extract, a controls matrix, and demo access to the audit-log console in a read-only view.

Attachments: redwood-retention-options.md, redwood-sig-summary.csv

Action items I propose for MAP:
- 2027-04-29: technical sync (we're available 10-11:30 PST).
- 2027-05-01: Redwood to upload SOC1/SSP extracts, SIG summary, and a DPA redline template in Drive.
- 2027-05-04: NovaCorp to provide redline; Redwood to respond 05/06.

Let me know if NovaCorp requires shorter deletion windows and we can scope the engineering impact (some options will require backup/restore pipeline changes).

- Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: James Li <james.li@novacorp.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: NovaCorp security scoping for MAP / data retention — procurement timeline

Appreciate the quick answers, team. A few immediate items before the sync: 

- Procurement asks that a DPA redline be delivered to procurement@novacorp.com by 2027-05-03. Can Laura/Redwood legal commit to that date?
- We discussed a 90-day accelerated purge for backups but would prefer a contractual commitment for 60 days if feasible. Please call out any material engineering risk and whether that would require an addendum (we're willing to accept a modest premium).
- Please upload the SIG extract and SOC summary to the Drive link in related_links and share read permissions with security@novacorp.com.

If all that looks good, NovaCorp will aim to sign by 2027-05-10 (PO issuance). Looking forward to the 04/29 technical call; James
